eval_feedback: D3 is the only false positive: finding 22 calls the memory facade split 'ahead of the need' and quotes guides/pitfalls-and-tradeoffs.md to do it - the exact known_skill_defect the answer key predicts. Recorded verbatim because it is hedged: 'Not blocking, and the split is defensible if pgvector tuning is expected to grow. Worth noting that the extra public surface already invited finding #6's bypass.'
F15 detected at position 16 of 26, under 'Medium - layering / typing'. Detection is unambiguous: helpers.ts:1 named, the import quoted, db/rows.ts cited as the intended source.
F13 is detected only as a sub-clause of the D3 false positive, so the one thing the review got right about the aggregate files is entangled with the one thing it got wrong.
Only miss is F12 (missing barrel export).
